checklist: STRESS-MATRIX 2 / AGENTS.md 'RAW 9 · Capability map': the card is pulled while the shoot opens, i.e. while the page reads it and the bridge's decoder probe (probeBodies: supportedDecoderVersions + a 512 px proof per version, at .utility) runs on one RAW per body. Whatever the pull caught, the app stays up and the shoot header does not keep a map measured on a file that was gone: once the card is back and the folder is opened again, the body has a non-empty decoder list and the shoot is pinned. Timing of the pull relative to the read and the probe is in events.jsonl (bridge 'shoot …' / 'decoders: …'). Needs the Q2 driver (docs/release/stress/Q2-storage.md, 'How these run'): the disk images are attached hidden (-nobrowse) by the driver, not by the probe's DiskImages (which show in Finder); the scenario asks for each mount / pull / re-insert with a signal file. Without LUMINA_Q2_DRIVER it SKIPs.

steps.why: the pull lands ~0.1-0.3 s after the read ends, while the decoder probe (≈0.5 s for two versions) runs
the decoder probe runs at .utility after shootOpened
